title: Planet Tweaks V2.9.6 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — True Zero-Delay Edit & Input Isolation Engine
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V2.9.6 NOVA TITAN: Ultra-low latency Drag Edit engine overhaul. Eliminated coarse thread delay for instantaneous 0.2ms sub-millisecond tile grabbing. Implemented strict user-bound key isolation—the macro strictly and only activates the keys you explicitly configure (zero ghost mouse clicks). Added active hardware watchdog and physical release verification to ensure zero stuck keys under any game or desktop condition.
